t: The Gazette-Mail reports the state certified a Boone County data center campus, "Project Country Roads" (up to 10 GW on 8,000 acres), by a Sept. 30 Commerce letter, without public notice.
Valley Link starts a second round of open houses and says it expects to file its preferred and alternate routes with state regulators early next year.
The PSC ends the MARL evidentiary hearings a day early. Briefs are due in November and a decision is expected by March 6, 2027.
Correction: DEP's own notice says written comments on Monarch's air permit R14-0042 are due before 5 p.m. Nov 13, not Oct 30 as earlier reported.
Stop Valley Link peaceful protest at the Barbour County Courthouse in Philippi.
NPR takes Ridgeline's dark-sky and ski-area fight national.
Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions in construction debt for Monarch's Anthropic building.
MARL evidentiary hearing opens at the PSC.
Monroe County residents protest a potential data center outside a landowner's law office in Giles County, VA.
AG J.B. McCuskey declines Berkeley County's request for an HB 2014 opinion, citing the Barks case.
Nscale's IPO filing (S-1) discloses Anthropic agreements worth up to approximately $44.6B for GPU capacity at Monarch.
Monarch and Tamarack are certified at The Greenbrier. Mason County now hosts two High Impact Data Centers.
The ICA dismisses the Ridgeline air-permit appeals on jurisdiction. The groups say they will refile.
